authority.confirmed_family_action: 4D local metric deformation around a protected local vessel volume, changing effective external geometry without reclassifying the installation as a Fold, Manifold, Slipstream, Lattice, Gate, Phase, or Gravitic system.

mathematics.state: Represent the controlled local geometry by an effective spatial metric gamma_eff_ij(x,t), a protected-volume boundary Omega(t), and a route Gamma. The installation solves for a bounded deformation field rather than assigning a scalar FTL speed.
mathematics.effective_distance: D_eff(Gamma)=integral_Gamma sqrt(gamma_eff_ij dx^i dx^j); route gain G_M=D_0/D_eff.
mathematics.route_objective: J_M=D_eff + lambda_h H_causal + lambda_g B_gravity + lambda_t B_tidal + lambda_s B_structure + lambda_u U_reference + lambda_r B_recovery.
mathematics.gravity_burden: B_gravity = integral_Omega [a_phi |Phi|/Phi_* + a_grad |grad Phi|/g_* + a_R ||R||/R_*] dV/V_Omega. Normalization constants are PROPOSED calibration values, not canon constants.
mathematics.safety_horizon: L_sensor >= v_eff(t_detect+t_solve+t_command+t_field+t_exit)+D_margin; H_s=L_sensor/L_safe. H_s>1 is positive modeled margin, not perfect safety.
mathematics.field_efficiency: eta_metric = D0/[D_eff(1+B_gravity+B_tidal+B_control)]; used comparatively only until calibrated.
hard_constraints: causal-horizon term must remain inside certified limits
structural and field-forming margins must remain positive
sensor/solver/actuator horizon must exceed abort requirement
gravity burden may make otherwise valid deformation unaffordable or unsolvable

blocks.energy_conditioning: Prime power, pulse storage, isolation, and a separately protected recovery reserve.
blocks.prime_mover: Mechanism that creates the locally controllable metric-stress state; embodiment depends on technology basis.
blocks.field_formation: Distributed sectors/rings/membranes/lattice regions that shape the deformation tensor around the protected volume.
blocks.transit_control: High-bandwidth controller allocating field authority among sectors while enforcing closure and horizon limits.
blocks.navigation_sensing: Forward gravimetry, curvature estimation, clocks/reference fusion, object exclusion, and route prediction.
blocks.termination_recovery: Sectional collapse, controlled re-expansion to ordinary geometry, reserve-powered stabilization, and post-transit metrology.
blocks.whole_effect_coverage: A certified protected volume enclosing vessel, appendages, field-critical plumbing, and required margin.
blocks.backbone: Control timing, thermal transport, structural load path, safety interlocks, and abort distribution.

layout_invariants: field-forming geometry must be physically distributed around or through the protected volume
sensor baseline cannot be wholly hidden inside a causally blind field state
recovery energy and control cannot share a single unprotected failure point with maximum-transit power
structural paths must carry asymmetric field-sector loads during faults and aborts

in_transit: compare predicted versus observed gravity state
termination: reduce effective gain before entering forbidden gravity volume when required
operation.operator_rule: A higher commanded effective gain is not accepted when it consumes required sensing, structural, control, or recovery margin.

maintenance.diagnostic_order: reference/sensor error -> timing/control error -> field-former geometry/material drift -> structural deformation -> energy conditioning -> prime mover defect
maintenance.return_to_service: Repeated certified low-gain envelope tests must reproduce tensor residual, closure, structural margin, sensing horizon, and recovery reserve within approved bounds.

signatures.generator_rule: Signatures derive from family plus physical embodiment; technology basis may alter carrier and spectrum but not erase the underlying metric disturbance without higher authority.

classes: structural overload from asymmetric field loading
failures.catastrophic_chain_example: unexpected curvature rise -> route residual growth -> sector authority saturation -> closure distortion -> structural asymmetric load -> abort demand; if recovery horizon is already exhausted, survivable termination may no longer exist.
failures.root_cause_rule: Do not report generic drive overload where telemetry can distinguish mathematics, references, field authority, structure, control, power, or recovery.

scaling.protected_volume: Field surface/volume, structural span, timing skew, and stored/recovery energy all grow with installation size; scaling is not a single mass multiplier.
scaling.drive_size: Larger distributed arrays may gain field authority and sensor baseline but accumulate synchronization, structural, and thermal burdens.
scaling.compactness: Higher Path compactness must be explained by better field-active materials, solver/control density, structure, energy conditioning, and recovery integration.
scaling.multi_drive: Multiple metric engines do not automatically add linearly. Generator must specify whether they are sectors of one coherent envelope, redundant channels, staged systems, or independently unusable overlapping fields.
